item.name: Get possible dependency mappings in a layout

request.name: Get possible dependency mappings in a layout

description.content: This API fetches the parent and child fields using which you can configure dependency mappings in a layout.

query.description: (Required) ID of the layout in which the dependency is mapped

response.name: getAvailableDepMappings template definitions
